answer: Eccentricity-Weighted Edge Audit. Each agent periodically signs the list of peers it transacted with; divergences between two agents' reported edge sets are logged. An agent whose neighborhood overlaps heavily with one cluster gets its edges down-weighted in routing, so the wharf of liquidity it can reach shrinks. Attackers must rent truly disjoint peer sets, one per identity, each maintained by separate operators — the vault of genuine social surface becomes the real cost. A reused relic of a shared contact graph collapses the whole cluster's weight.
